notes.subject: raet bilong ol samting
notes.rationale: Stat 20:17 putum haus pastaim na meri bihain; hia long Dut 5:21 meri i pastaim — ol man i tanim tok ol i no gat wanpela mining long dispela senis.

notes.subject: תחמד / תתאוה
notes.rationale: Tupela tok bilong laikim samting bilong narapela man, olsem na em i gat klostu mining — Tok Pisin mi usim tupela pasin bilong tok.

translation: Na yu no ken laikim wantaim olgeta meri bilong poro man i stap klostu long yu, na yu no ken strongpela long laikim haus bilong poro man i stap klostu long yu, gaden bilong en, wokman bilong en na meri wokman bilong en, bulmakau man bilong en na donki bilong en, na olgeta samting bilong poro man i stap klostu long yu.
